scripts.build:admin: node scripts/build-cert-single.mjs && node scripts/sync-cert.mjs && pnpm --dir admin build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:admin && pnpm exec wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm build:admin && pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.staging.toml
scripts.test:visual: pnpm build:admin && pnpm exec vite-node scripts/generate-report-fixtures.ts && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:visual:gate: pnpm build:admin && pnpm exec vite-node scripts/generate-report-fixtures.ts && pnpm exec playwright test --grep-invert @production
scripts.test:visual:prod: pnpm build:admin && pnpm exec vite-node scripts/generate-report-fixtures.ts && pnpm exec playwright test --grep @production
scripts.test:visual:update: pnpm build:admin && pnpm exec vite-node scripts/generate-report-fixtures.ts && pnpm exec playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.build:tool: bun build ./tools/survey-tool/main.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile ./tools/survey-tool/dist/survey-tool-linux-x64 && bun build ./tools/survey-tool/main.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile ./tools/survey-tool/dist/survey-tool-windows-x64.exe && bun build ./tools/survey-tool/main.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile ./tools/survey-tool/dist/survey-tool-darwin-arm64
